raw_comment:
What do you noice?
I noticed that at first glance there's no particular pattern of the severe droughts of the United States. But, I did notice that there were more severe droughts in the flatter areas of the states (most often) after studying the graph for a few minutes.
What do you wonder?
I wondered why some southern states got severe droughts, whereas other southern states did not have much drought at all (I had guessed that the more southern states would have more droughts but there was no relevance). I also wonder why the coasts are less droughts?
Relationship to community?
The relationship is that recently I have noticed more droughts and less precipitation in the summer months (at least) and fall but I have no idea why.
Name for Graph: The United States is getting drier than my parents texting!
